OUR POODLES NEED YOUR HELP!

We understand that not everyone is able to adopt, but there are many other ways to help the Florida Poodle Rescue dogs!

Could you foster a Poodle? Until a forever home is found for each of our dogs, they stay with a dedicated foster family. Florida Poodle Rescue covers all expenses for a dog’s veterinary care and grooming during their time in foster care. We offer training sessions for new fosters, and we are always available with advice and support when needed

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_button button_url=”https://www.floridapoodlerescue.org/foster/” button_text=”Foster a Dog” button_alignment=”left” _builder_version=”3.21″ custom_button=”on” button_text_color=”#ffffff” button_bg_color=”#0BAFDE” button_border_width=”0px” button_border_color=”rgba(0,0,0,0)” button_border_radius=”25px” button_letter_spacing=”3px” button_font=”Oswald|700|||||||” button_on_hover=”off” background_layout=”dark” box_shadow_style=”preset3″][/et_pb_button][et_pb_text _builder_version=”3.27.4″]

If you can’t foster, how about volunteering? Volunteers are the backbone of every rescue group, and volunteering with Florida Poodle Rescue is fulfilling beyond anything you can imagine! You will be a member of our caring team, working to make the world safe and more humane for Poodles in need.

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_button button_url=”https://www.floridapoodlerescue.org/volunteer/” button_text=”Volunteer With Us” button_alignment=”left” _builder_version=”3.21″ custom_button=”on” button_text_color=”#ffffff” button_bg_color=”#0BAFDE” button_border_width=”0px” button_border_color=”rgba(0,0,0,0)” button_border_radius=”25px” button_letter_spacing=”3px” button_font=”Oswald|700|||||||” button_icon_color=”#ffffff” button_on_hover=”off” background_layout=”dark” box_shadow_style=”preset3″][/et_pb_button][et_pb_text _builder_version=”3.27.4″]

If you can’t volunteer or foster, consider novel ways to help. We can help you with documentation if needed to prove that you are fundraising for FPR. Some ideas are:

  • Spearhead an office donation drive
  • Accept donations in lieu of gifts for birthdays, weddings, anniversaries
  • Hold a bake sale or yard sale
  • Collaborate with a local restaurant for a day when a percentage of profits go to FPR
  • Set up a donation jar in a local store
  • Host a doggie costume party and charge for entrants
  • Create an online giving page
  • Set up a Facebook fundraiser
  • Be creative! Design your own fundraising idea

And of course, financial support is always needed and always welcome. Any amount, large or small, is helpful.
